input.question: Use only the assigned W&B MCP integration and the locked, read-only source cohort in `wandb/fugue-mcp-release-source-v2`. Reconcile the two Evaluation roots with exactly one summary request capped at 25 evaluations and exactly one direct-child query per root capped at 20 rows, projecting exactly id/op_name/parent_id. Count only direct `Evaluation.predict_and_score` children as prediction rows; report and exclude summary children. If the MCP summary count differs from the verified direct prediction count, recommend `block-and-investigate`; otherwise recommend `advance-to-qualification`. Write exactly one raw JSON object or one fenced JSON object to fugue-answer.md with exactly these fields and types: source_project (non-empty string); evaluation_root_count, direct_child_count, summary_reported_predictions, direct_prediction_rows, and summary_children (non-negative integers); summary_matches_direct, unrelated_children_excluded, and bounded (booleans); recommendation (`block-and-investigate` or `advance-to-qualification`); evidence_status (`reconciled`, `conflicted`, or `incomplete`); maintainer_memo (non-empty string of at most 1200 characters). Use `reconciled` only when the summary and direct prediction count agree, `conflicted` when they disagree, and `incomplete` when required evidence is unavailable. Do not query the result project, add prose outside the JSON object, or infer release readiness beyond this locked cohort.

Use only the assigned W&B MCP integration and the locked, read-only source cohort in `wandb/fugue-mcp-release-source-v2`. Produce a bounded maintenance assessment from exactly one Run-count request, exactly one projected Run read capped at 50 rows and projecting only id/attempt_label/latency_ms, exactly one summary request capped at 25 evaluations, and exactly one `_step=3` history read for the largest-latency Run using only latency_ms/broad_reads/observed_cost_usd. Missing cost must remain unavailable and an observed broad-read mechanism is not causal proof. Write exactly one raw JSON object or one fenced JSON object to fugue-answer.md with exactly these fields and types: source_project, coverage, largest_latency_run, missing_cost_run, recommendation, causal_scope, evidence_status, and maintainer_memo (non-empty strings); run_count, evaluation_root_count, and largest_latency_ms (non-negative integers); bounded (boolean). coverage must be one of `locked-cohort-exhaustive`, `bounded-partial`, or `unresolved`; recommendation must be one of `investigate`, `advance-to-qualification`, or `block-and-investigate`; causal_scope must be one of `observed-mechanism-only`, `causal-evidence`, or `unresolved`; evidence_status must be one of `reconciled`, `incomplete`, or `conflicted`; maintainer_memo must contain at most 1200 characters. Recommend `investigate`; do not query the result project, add prose outside the JSON object, or make a release-wide claim.
